_comment: Teams with no machine-readable schedule. Everything else in the Sports tab comes from a feed (see scripts/build_sports.py). Add games as {title, start (ISO with offset), date, venue, url, home}. Vermont Green FC types its schedule into a WordPress page — no plugin, no ICS, no league API — and its season runs May-August, so this sits empty most of the year. The Burlington Revolution has published NO games: their site says 'Game times will be announced'.
